name: Lords Alliance Agent
description: Origin Feat You gain the following benefits.

Inspiring Strike.description: Once per turn when you score a Critical Hit against a creature, you can choose an ally within 30 feet of yourself who can see or hear you and who lacks Heroic Inspiration. That ally gains Heroic Inspiration.

Reassert Honor.description: When an enemy you can see deals damage to an ally of yours that is within 5 feet of you, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that enemy before the end of your next turn.
